name: AdvancedMaterials
description: Adds Blender-like PBR material controls as an object behavior for 3D boxes, 3D models, and extruded sprites while preserving existing textures and maps unless a replacement option is enabled.
author: Antigravity

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: AdvancedMaterials
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Adds physical material controls to a 3D object as a reusable behavior, preserving original material assignments and texture maps unless explicitly changed.

propertyDescriptors.label: Replace Base Color
propertyDescriptors.description: Replace the material base color. Leave disabled to preserve the original texture and color.
propertyDescriptors.name: UseBaseColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Base Color
propertyDescriptors.description: Replacement base color used only when Replace Base Color is enabled.
propertyDescriptors.name: BaseColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Transmission
propertyDescriptors.description: Transmission from 0 to 1. Useful for glass, water, and other transparent physical materials.
propertyDescriptors.name: Transmission

propertyDescriptors.label: IOR
propertyDescriptors.description: Index of refraction from 1.0 to 2.333. Glass is usually around 1.5.
propertyDescriptors.name: IOR

propertyDescriptors.label: Thickness
propertyDescriptors.description: Transmission thickness used for volumetric refraction.
propertyDescriptors.name: Thickness

propertyDescriptors.label: Clearcoat
propertyDescriptors.description: Clearcoat amount from 0 to 1. Useful for car paint, varnish, and wet looks.
propertyDescriptors.name: Clearcoat

propertyDescriptors.label: Use Emission
propertyDescriptors.description: Enable emissive color and strength controls.
propertyDescriptors.name: UseEmission

propertyDescriptors.label: Emission Color
propertyDescriptors.description: Emissive color used when emission is enabled.
propertyDescriptors.name: EmissionColor

propertyDescriptors.label: Emission Strength
propertyDescriptors.description: Emissive intensity. Use values above 1 for stronger glow with bloom/post-processing.
propertyDescriptors.name: EmissionStrength

propertyDescriptors.label: Alpha Mode
propertyDescriptors.description: Alpha mode. Preserve keeps the original material transparency settings.
propertyDescriptors.name: AlphaMode

propertyDescriptors.label: Render Side
propertyDescriptors.description: Rendered side. Preserve keeps the original material side setting.
propertyDescriptors.name: Side
